Write Crystal code implementing module Answer with self.merge_ranges(ranges : Array(Tuple(Int32, Int32))) : Array(Tuple(Int32, Int32)).
Inputs are closed integer intervals with start <= end, in arbitrary order. Return sorted intervals with all overlaps merged. Intervals touching at the same endpoint merge; intervals separated by one integer do NOT merge (for example {1,2} and {3,4} stay separate). Handle empty input, duplicate and nested ranges, negatives and Int32 limits. Do not mutate input. Use only the standard library; no I/O, files, processes or macros. Output only one complete Crystal code block, no explanation, no tests. Keep it short. This is a pure library function.
